verdict.rationale: Digits ships a documented, hosted official MCP server at https://api.digits.com/mcp with OAuth against a user's own account, listed setup steps for Claude Desktop/Code, ChatGPT, Cursor, and Perplexity, and this is independently confirmed live via a probe showing a proper auth-gated JSON-RPC endpoint with RFC 9728 metadata. Missing for 10: broader independent third-party hands-on usage reports beyond the vendor docs and one live probe.
